reconcile_note: cig_portforwording_add reads four cgi values with cgiFormString (uStack_1c, var_24h, uStack_2c and acStack_2e). Every one of them flows only into the two safe_system calls at *0xbdac. The callee at 0x000092a8 is safe_system, whose body (delivered) packs its varargs into a discrete argv[] array and calls safe_exec, which fork()s and runs execvp(argv0, argv). There is no shell string on this path, so cgi metacharacters stay literal argv elements and cannot inject a command. The only raw system() call takes the fixed constant *0x0000bdd4 = "killall -1 asaeiiim >/dev/null", with no cgi value spliced in. The sprintf results and the xml path constants (for example *0x0000bdf0) feed only xml_set_str / xml_write_file config writes at 0x000092b4, never a command sink. Delivering both on-target items is needed and sufficient: the safe_system body proves the user-data path uses discrete-argv exec, and the constant proves the raw system() argument carries no user data. Dropping either leaves the verdict undecidable. Terminal is not-vulnerable. The upstream session check sym.check_login (0xe2b4) gates this handler, so the requested command runs only for a request that already holds a valid session.
